cubelandmetiers.ui.livrer.bulle: Deliver what you carry for this order
cubelandmetiers.ui.pas_au_carnet.detail: read MAKE: cook it once, that's all
cubelandmetiers.ui.livraison_paie: A delivery pays %d %% of the price.
cubelandmetiers.ui.etape.carnet: Take the dish: it goes into your notebook with its quality.
cubelandmetiers.ui.etape.premiere: First batch: the recipe writes itself into your notebook.
cubelandmetiers.ui.etape.jei: Key U (JEI): the exact recipe layout.
cubelandmetiers.ui.etape.palier_requis: Tier %d required (you are at %d): the dish will have no effect.
cubelandmetiers.ui.tu_debloqueras: Cook different recipes to open the next station.
cubelandmetiers.metier.pecheur.resume: Pull catches out of the water.
cubelandmetiers.metier.cuisinier.resume: Cook dishes, discover new ones, climb tiers.
cubelandmetiers.palier.1.recompense: The campfire, the stove and the cutting board.
cubelandmetiers.palier.2.recompense: The skillet. An iron knife and the cook's apron.
cubelandmetiers.palier.3.recompense: The cooking pot, and the supplier's best-paying orders.
cubelandmetiers.palier.4.recompense: The kettle, and the recipe book sold by the shop.
cubelandmetiers.palier.5.recompense: The Nether, and the master's toque: a worn artefact everyone can see.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.planche.geste.2: Right-click: put the ingredient down, then cut it with a knife.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.planche.geste.3: Pick up the result next to the board.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.poele.geste.1: Place a skillet on a stove or a fire.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.poele.geste.2: Right-click, add the ingredients, wait until they brown.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.poele.geste.3: Take the dish out of the skillet.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.marmite.geste.1: Place a cooking pot on a stove.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.marmite.geste.2: Right-click, add the ingredients (a bowl if needed).
cubelandmetiers.atelier.marmite.geste.3: Wait, then take the dish out of the pot.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.bouilloire.geste: Place the kettle near a heat source.
Right-click, pour in the ingredients, wait for the brew.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.feu_de_camp.gest: Right-click with the ingredient to put it on.
Wait until it pops off, then pick it up.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.fumoir.geste.2: Put the ingredient on top, wait.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.haut_fourneau.ge: Open a blast furnace, add fuel.
Put the ingredient in, wait, take it.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.four.geste.1: Open a furnace, add fuel at the bottom.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.four.geste.2: Put the ingredient on top, wait for it to cook.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.four.geste.3: Take the dish from the right slot.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.fourneau.geste.1: Place a stove and light it.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.fourneau.geste.2: Put the ingredient on top, wait for it to cook.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.etabli.geste.1: Open a crafting table (or the inventory if it fits in 2×2).
cubelandmetiers.atelier.etabli.geste.2: Lay the ingredients out as on the left.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.tonneau.geste.1: Open the keg, add the ingredients.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.tonneau.geste.2: Wait for fermentation, then draw the dish.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.nether.geste.1: It is prepared in the Nether, at the station shown.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.nether.geste.2: Add the ingredients, wait, take the dish.
cubelandmetiers.atelier.autre.geste.1: Right-click the station, add the ingredients, wait.
cubelandmetiers.quete.decouverte.famille: Cook %d dish(es) from the %s family you don't know yet.
cubelandmetiers.quete.livraison.qualite: The supplier wants %d × %s, %s quality or better.
cubelandmetiers.quete.livraison.defi: Challenge: deliver %d × %s, a dish from the tier above. Succeed and it's unlocked for good.
cubelandmetiers.quete.maitrise.qualite: Cook a dish at %s quality or better.
cubelandmetiers.quete.maitrise.servir: Have another player eat one of your dishes.
cubelandmetiers.premiers_pas.0.detail: Click a cooking station: stove, campfire, cutting board. That's where dishes come to life.
cubelandmetiers.premiers_pas.1.detail: Cook any tier 1 dish: grilled meat, a fish, a salad. It writes itself into your notebook.
cubelandmetiers.premiers_pas.2.detail: Eat what you just cooked. Each dish family gives its effect, longer with quality.
cubelandmetiers.premiers_pas.3.detail: Hold a dish and type /cuisinier vendre. Quality sets the price.
cubelandmetiers.premiers_pas.4.detail: The supplier places an order, right below. Cook what it asks and click Deliver.
cubelandmetiers.annonce.premiers_pas_fin: The notebook now offers three orders. Happy cooking.
cubelandmetiers.msg.hors_palier: This dish needs tier %d: no effect and no value until you get there.
cubelandmetiers.msg.fabrication_bloquee: This dish needs tier %d. You are at tier %d.
cubelandmetiers.msg.rien_a_livrer: Nothing to deliver in your inventory: it takes dishes you cooked yourself, at the requested quality.
cubelandmetiers.cmd.tenir_plat: Hold the dish in your main hand.
cubelandmetiers.cmd.hors_palier: This dish was cooked above tier: nobody wants it.
cubelandmetiers.cmd.rien_a_vendre: No sellable dish in your inventory.
cubelandmetiers.cmd.boutique_muette: The shop is not answering: nothing was sold, your dishes are still here.
cubelandmetiers.cmd.recharge: Cubeland Jobs %s · reloaded: %d dishes, %d jobs. Connected players received the new settings.
cubelandmetiers.cmd.repris: Experience taken over from the shop for %d player(s).
cubelandmetiers.accueil.1: Mine, cut, farm, hunt, fish: every action makes you climb.
cubelandmetiers.accueil.2: Cook too, and there it's the different recipes that count, not the amount.
cubelandmetiers.accueil.3: Key J, or /metiers, to see everything. The cooking notebook guides you step by step.
cubelandmetiers.guide.debuter.1: Cook at a station: stove, cutting board, skillet, cooking pot. Every dish that comes out of a station goes into your notebook with its quality.
cubelandmetiers.guide.debuter.2: Different recipes raise your tiers, not the amount you cook.
cubelandmetiers.guide.debuter.3: A dish found in a chest, bought or received doesn't count: only what you cook enters the notebook.
cubelandmetiers.guide.debuter.4: A dish above your tier comes out with no effect and no value.
cubelandmetiers.guide.commandes.1: Three orders are always open in the Cooking tab, one of each kind. None can fail.
cubelandmetiers.guide.commandes.decouver: Discovery: dishes you don't know yet. +%d XP, and the next tier gets closer.
cubelandmetiers.guide.commandes.livraiso: Delivery: dishes you know, in quantity. Paid %d %% of the price, no fee.
cubelandmetiers.guide.commandes.maitrise: Mastery: a quality, your favourite, or another player eating your dish. +%d XP.
cubelandmetiers.guide.commandes.2: An unfulfilled delivery is replaced after %d minutes. The other two wait.
cubelandmetiers.guide.commandes.3: One delivery in four is a challenge from the tier above: succeed and the dish is unlocked for good.
cubelandmetiers.guide.familles.1: Eating a dish gives its family's effect. The higher the quality, the longer it lasts.
cubelandmetiers.guide.familles.2: At Signature quality, a second effect specific to the family is added.
cubelandmetiers.guide.qualites.1: Every cooked dish draws a quality. Climbing tiers improves the draw a lot.
cubelandmetiers.guide.qualites.2: Keep a knife on you to help the draw: iron +%d %%, diamond or gold +%d %%, netherite +%d %%, neptunium +%d %% chance to go up one step.
cubelandmetiers.guide.vendre.1: Every dish has a base value, shown in the book, multiplied by its quality:
cubelandmetiers.guide.vendre.cmd.vendre: /cuisinier vendre — sells the stack in hand
cubelandmetiers.guide.vendre.cmd.tout: /cuisinier vendre tout — sells every dish in the inventory
cubelandmetiers.guide.vendre.cmd.prix: /cuisinier prix — estimates the dish in hand without selling
cubelandmetiers.guide.vendre.commission: The shop keeps a %d %% fee on every sale, never on a delivery.
cubelandmetiers.guide.vendre.2: Dishes cooked above tier find no buyer.
